classification_reasons: Spec is tight: every open question answered with the intent's recommendation, the one flagged concern closed by panel #1, acceptance measurable (exact stdout lines, exit codes, stub calls).
Blast radius is not small: a new module app/backtest/sweep.py and a refactor of the existing `run` sub-command's argument and output code into shared helpers in app/backtest/__main__.py.

The new behaviour (list parsing, skip counting, the 400 cap, ranking, table layout) has no existing coverage; tests/test_backtest_cli.py only pins `run` through the refactor. No risk-list item, no schema, no data-layer or __all__ change.
attempted: Intent: re-checked every intent outcome (command shape, shared args with run's defaults and messages, comma lists with dedup, order and candle-count skips counted, single load, row contents equal to run's, sort with ties by fast then slow, output order, the refusals incl. the 400 cap counted on kept pairs before loading and the every-pair-skipped range, offline tests, run unchanged, no new public name, CLAUDE.md lines for the owner) against R1-R15 and the Design. All covered; the run line wording '9 pairs tried, 0 skipped' departs from the sketch only where the intent leaves the layout to the design.

Spec and plan after the panel: panel #2's fix is applied (plan step 1 now expects `count_pairs([5, 50], [10, 50]) == (2, 2)`, which matches bisect_right per fast: fast 5 keeps 10 and 50, fast 50 skips both). Panel #1 is applied: spec's concern is marked decided, plan Risks corrects the aside (bare `-5` is a value on every version), and the Proof cases add two-word `--fast -5` (R4 message) and two-word `--fast -5,10` (exit 2, empty stdout, no stub call only). The spec concern's original body still carries the superseded 'run --fast -5 on some versions' aside, but the decided line and plan.md correct it; a text nit, not a reason.

Plan arithmetic re-checked: defaults give 9 kept, 0 skipped; `--fast 2,3,5 --slow 5,8,12,24` on the 24-candle SPOT_1H day gives 11 kept, 1 order skip, 3 candle skips (slow 24 >= 24) so 8 tried and 4 skipped; 1..21 by 22..42 is 441 > 400; defaults on 24 candles skip all 9 by candle count (R8 refusal); 120 hourly synthetic candles from 2026-09-28 fill 09-28..10-02 exactly, end before the clock's NOW 2026-10-03, and 120 > 100.

Negative-item paths: two-word `--fast -5` reaches `_lengths` (argparse treats '-5' as a value when no option looks like a negative number), `_length` gives int -5, the `< 1` check gives 'fast -5 is not a whole number of at least 1' as R4 says. Two-word `--fast -5,10` is an argparse SystemExit(2) on 3.10-3.13 and a returned 2 on 3.14; the test must accept both (catch SystemExit and read its code) and argparse also prints usage on stderr, which is why the plan pins only exit 2, empty stdout and no call. Builder detail, not a design gap.

Proof: design phase, no toolchain logs expected. Proof lists 16 tests in a new file; refusal tests assert empty stdout, one error line and `kucoin.calls == []` (except the post-load R8 refusal), mirroring test_backtest_cli.py. 'Loaded once' compares stub calls with one `run` and also counts calls of a monkeypatched module-global `load_klines`, which `_load` resolves at call time.

Blast radius: the diff touches only the change folder; no guardrail file. The only caller of __main__.py is `python -m`; `main` stays unchanged and already maps BacktestInputError and OSError to exit 2. `run` is pinned by the unchanged tests/test_backtest_cli.py plus a new option-order help test. __all__ unchanged so test_public_api holds. CLAUDE.md drift is named for the owner. No risk-list item applies (no hits).

Policies: security-baseline rule 2 (input bounded by the 400 cap, counted by bisect before the grid is built), no eval/exec/shell, only load_klines's existing network call; coding-standards (type hints, one new test module, no dependency: bisect, dataclasses, polars); ux-and-brand (each message says what to pass, copy as module constants); data-conventions correctly not applicable.

Tests: tie test uses constant closes, where rolling fast mean equals slow mean so the strict `>` in sma_cross_positions gives no position and return exactly 0.0, making the fast/slow tiebreak observable. Expected rows are computed independently via load_klines(cache=False), sma_cross_positions and run_backtest, so a wrong formatter, pair or sort would fail. Feature change; no existing test edited.
Skip markers: not applicable at design; the plan declares none.

Claims against today's code (app/backtest/__main__.py, strategy.py, tests/kucoin_stub.py, tests/conftest.py): `_length(text, name)` with the `{name} {text!r} is not a whole number of at least 1` message, `_fee`, `_percent`, `SMA_NOTE`, `RUN_HELP` exist; run's option order is --market, --fast, --slow, --fee, --cache-dir; run refuses `frame.height <= slow`; buy and hold is `run_backtest(frame, [1] * frame.height, fee=fee)` printed `{label:<14}{value:>8}`; `make_request(..., loader.utc_now().date())`; STRATEGY_NAME 'sma-cross'; validate_lengths' wording; KuCoin.calls, add_spot_synthetic(start, count, interval_ms), utc(), SPOT_1H exist; the clock fixture patches loader.utc_now. All match. docs/decisions/index.md does not exist and the spec cites no decision.
Drive: not applicable at design; commands.drive is not referenced by the plan.
